figurative_meaning_en: To come into possession; to be obtained or acquired
example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই গুরুত্বপূর্ণ নথিটি তার হাতে পড়ে গেল।
এই সুযোগটি আমার হাতে পড়েছে, এখন কাজ শুরু করব।
example_sentences_in_english: That important document fell into his hands.
This opportunity has come into my hands; now I'll start working on it.
note: This idiom reflects everyday Bengali expressions of gaining control or possession over something unexpectedly.
